title: Five habits that keep AI on track
look: Session board: a track with five gates, habit cards, a vague and a clear ask, and Sensei's checks on a dot-grid desk. Plain. Colors and type from the Zen-Sumi design system: washi paper, sumi ink, rationed vermillion for guesses, jade for what is settled. The Sensei mark on the close.

scenes.name: On track
scenes.desc: Keep AI on track with five habits: the work passes five gates along its path.

scenes.name: The habits
scenes.desc: Requirements written and read, verification defined first, the design agreed, phases with checks, conventions as rules.

scenes.name: Less room to guess
scenes.desc: A vague ask leaves gaps the AI fills with guesses; requirements and a verification definition close them.

scenes.name: Habits you can see
scenes.desc: Sensei scores the plan's depth, flags departures from it, and turns repeated corrections into rules.

scenes.name: Sensei
scenes.desc: End card with the Sensei mark: less room to guess.
